Meža meitas

Reinsone, Sanita. Meža meitas. 12 women on life at home, in the forest and in prison. Riga: Dienas Grāmata, 2015 (second edition, 2022). “Meža meitas” was staged at Valmiera Drama Theatre, directed by Mārtiņš Eihe (premiere: January 2018).
